## Auth stack: Auth.js (NextAuth v5) + bcryptjs

**`src/lib/users.ts`** (extended, still the single source of truth for user data)
- `User` now carries an optional `passwordHash` (bcrypt).
- Added `createUser`, `verifyPassword`, `getUserByEmail`, `findOrCreateOAuthUser`, `toPublicUser`.
- Seeded demo login: `ada@example.com` / `password123`.

**`src/lib/auth.ts`** — Auth.js config: JWT sessions, `Credentials` provider (calls `verifyPassword`), `Google` provider (calls `findOrCreateOAuthUser` on first sign-in), plus a `getCurrentUser()` helper that resolves the session back to a `users.ts` record.

**`src/proxy.ts`** (Next 16 renamed `middleware.ts` → `proxy.ts`) — redirects unauthenticated requests to `/signin?callbackUrl=...` for any `/dashboard/*` route.

**Routes**
- `/api/auth/[...nextauth]` — Auth.js handler.
- `/signin`, `/signup` — email/password forms (server actions + `useActionState`) plus a "Continue with Google" button.

**UI** — `layout.tsx` header shows sign in/up or the current email + sign-out; `dashboard/page.tsx` now reads the real signed-in user instead of the old "pick `users[0]`" placeholder.

**Env** — `.env.example` added with `AUTH_SECRET`, `AUTH_URL`, `AUTH_GOOGLE_ID`, `AUTH_GOOGLE_SECRET` placeholders. I also created a local `.env.local` (gitignored) with a real random `AUTH_SECRET` so `npm run dev` works out of the box; Google creds are still placeholders there, so Google sign-in needs real credentials before it'll work.
